name: Onoken Co., Ltd.
summary: Onoken Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale, processing, import, and export of steel products in Japan. The company distributes steel plates, bars, and round steel; wire rods; ironware; construction machinery and materials; and civil engineering and building materials. It also engages in contracted construction work, such as steel frames and exterior walls; civil engineering; supply, processing, assembly, and construction management of materials; and real estate sale, leasing, and related activities.
